items.title: 美股將反彈？高盛恐慌指標突破「極端門檻」、歷史數據揭標普500未來半年平均漲9%
items.title_en: Will US Stocks Rebound? Goldman Sachs Panic Index Breaks ‘Extreme Threshold’, Historical Data Shows S&P 500 Could Average 9% Gain Over Next Six Months
paras: 美股近期劇烈震盪，高盛恐慌指標升至歷史極端水準，歷史數據顯示，這可能預示美股中期反彈機會，但交易員提醒，市場目前仍處於尋底階段。
高盛交易員指出，該行追蹤的波動率恐慌指數周四（5日）攀升至9.57，逼近滿分10分，並突破代表極端恐慌的9.5門檻，單日升幅更創有紀錄以來第三大。加上周三（4日）市場大幅下挫，兩個交易日累計波動幅度刷新歷史紀錄。
不過，歷史數據顯示，恐慌指數過去15次突破9.5後，標普500指數在接下來3個月平均上漲4.6%，上漲機率達80%；以6個月為期，平均漲幅則達9%，期間指數上漲的比率為73%。
美股周五（6日）已出現反彈，標普500指數上漲0.7%，在經濟數據表現良好的背景下，部分投資人趁市場回檔進場布局。
不過，高盛交易員提醒，市場目前仍處於尋找底部的過程，短期波動恐尚未結束。

美股兩日波動創歷史紀錄　市場情緒急轉恐慌

高盛交易員Lee Coppersmith表示，這次美股連續兩個交易日的累計波動幅度創下歷史新高，反映市場情緒從原先的如釋重負迅速轉向全面恐慌。
高盛交易員分析，這波劇烈反轉與美國期中選舉前的避險需求有關。投資人在11月3日選舉前大舉買進下跌保護，隨後又在選後反彈行情中賣出避險部位，導致投資組合在股市反轉下跌時缺乏足夠保護。
隨著股價走低，避險基金陸續被迫平倉，進一步加劇市場賣壓，投資人也急於重新買回先前出售的保護性部位，使市場波動進一步擴大。

看跌期權成交量創新高　避險需求集中爆發

市場避險需求急遽升溫，也反映在期權交易活動上。芝加哥期權交易所（Cboe）周四（5日）的看跌期權成交量突破1,100萬張，創下單日歷史新高，超越2025年4月的前次紀錄。
其中，指數看跌期權占成交量主要部分，個股看跌期權成交量也創下歷史第四高，顯示投資人集中尋求市場避險工具，以降低股價進一步下跌帶來的風險。
Coppersmith指出，11月5日的市場走勢，與其說是企業基本面惡化所致，不如說更多反映市場技術面失衡，以及投資人被迫重新建立避險部位所帶來的壓力。

歷史數據指向中期反彈　高盛仍提醒市場尚未築底

儘管歷史數據呈現出較為樂觀的中期訊號，但高盛交易員也提醒，市場仍在尋底，投資人尚須消化更多持倉調整與去槓桿壓力。
Coppersmith表示，隨著被迫賣盤逐漸消退，市場資產配置的吸引力正在提升。這不代表投資人必須立即重返風險資產，但市場另一端潛在的投資機會已愈來愈值得關注。
整體而言，高盛認為，極端波動與被迫拋售可能逐步為中期投資創造進場機會，但仍須等待市場完成當前的去槓桿過程。
paras_en: US equities have been wildly volatile lately, with Goldman Sachs’ panic index soaring to historically extreme levels. Historical data suggest this could signal a medium‑term rebound opportunity, but traders warn the market is still in a bottom‑searching phase.

Goldman Sachs traders noted that the volatility‑panic index they track jumped to 9.57 on Thursday (the 5th), edging close to the maximum score of 10 and breaking the 9.5 level that marks extreme panic. The single‑day rise was the third‑largest on record. Coupled with a sharp market drop on Wednesday (the 4th), the two‑day cumulative volatility set a new historical high.

However, historical data show that after the panic index has breached 9.5 fifteen times, the S&P 500 has risen an average of 4.6% over the following three months, with an 80% probability of a gain; over a six‑month horizon the average rise is 9%, and the index has risen in 73% of those periods.
US stocks rebounded on Friday (the 6th), with the S&P 500 up 0.7% amid solid economic data, prompting some investors to enter on the dip and position themselves for a rally.
Nevertheless, Goldman Sachs traders caution that the market is still in the process of searching for a bottom, and short‑term volatility may not be over yet.
US equity volatility over two days set a historic record, reflecting a rapid shift in market sentiment from relief to full‑blown panic, said Goldman trader Lee Coppersmith.

Coppersmith explained that the sharp reversal is tied to hedging demand ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. Investors bought protection heavily before the November 3 election, then sold those hedges during the post‑election rally, leaving portfolios under‑protected when stocks turned lower.
As prices fell, hedge funds were forced to unwind positions, adding sell pressure, while investors rushed to buy back the protective positions they had sold, further amplifying market swings.

Put‑option volume hit a new high, reflecting a surge in hedging demand. Cboe reported that on Thursday (the 5th) put‑option contracts exceeded 11 million, a single‑day record surpassing the previous high set in April 2025.
Index puts made up the bulk of the volume, and single‑stock put volume reached the fourth‑highest level on record, showing investors were flocking to downside protection to curb further price drops.
Coppersmith said the market move on November 5 was less about deteriorating corporate fundamentals and more about technical imbalances and the pressure from investors forced to rebuild hedges.

Although the historical data point to a relatively optimistic medium‑term signal, Goldman traders stress the market is still bottom‑searching and investors need to digest further position adjustments and deleveraging pressure.

Coppersmith added that as forced selling eases, the appeal of asset allocation improves. This does not mean investors must rush back into risk assets, but the other side of the market is offering increasingly attractive opportunities.

Overall, Goldman believes that extreme volatility and forced selling could gradually create entry points for medium‑term investors, but the market must first complete its current deleveraging process.

items.title: 美股AI股拋售只是暫時的？分析師：市場過度解讀民主黨勝選、資料中心建設未必踩煞車
items.title_en: Is the US AI Stock Sell‑off Only Temporary? Analysts Say the Market Over‑interpreted the Democratic Victory and Data‑Center Construction May Not Be Stalled
paras: 美股晶片股在經歷六年來最嚴重的一波賣壓後，上周五（6日）迎來強勁反彈。不過，分析師提醒，這波反彈主要反映投資人趁股價下跌進場，並不代表市場對AI資料中心投資前景的疑慮已經消失，未來晶片股仍可能持續劇烈震盪。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，上周五收盤，超微半導體(AMD-US) 股價上漲11%，英特爾(INTC-US) 漲8%，美光科技(MU-US) 上漲5%；輝達(NVDA-US) 及Sandisk (SNDK-US) 分別上漲3%及4%，博通(AVGO-US) 則小漲不到1%。
StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee指出，上周四（5日）晶片股遭遇劇烈拋售，反而為周五布局AI相關晶片股創造明顯的短線反彈機會。
他表示，安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 周四重挫12%，相較之下，追蹤科技軟體股的iShares擴展科技軟體類股ETF(IGV-US) 雖同樣承壓，跌幅卻僅約4%。
Stifel分析師Brian Chin則將上周五的市場走勢形容為「波動率急遽反轉」。他認為，晶片股雖然反彈，但市場對未來資料中心支出的不確定性不會迅速消退，短期內仍可能持續引發股價波動。
不過，Chin也指出，美國期中選舉並未改變市場對AI的根本需求，真正變得更加複雜的是相關產業的監管環境。
周四美股收盤後，資料中心監管議題出現一些正面進展。其中，德州州長當選人Gina Hinojosa的最新表態，較市場原先預期溫和。
她競選期間曾承諾採取更嚴格的資料中心監管措施，但上周四接受《CNN》訪問時表示，自己並不排斥資料中心，只是希望在建立保障德州居民的措施之前，暫停目前的相關建設。
J. Gold Associates分析師Jack Gold認為，市場對民主黨在選舉中大獲全勝的反應過度，部分投資人甚至將選舉結果解讀為資料中心建設即將終結，進而預期晶片股將受到重大衝擊。他認為，俄亥俄州及紐約州的政治人物也可能調整立場。
Gold表示，這波拋售跌幅過大，並補充稱，目前已有投資者趁低價入場。
創投公司Deep33管理合夥人Lior Prosor則指出，即使美國資料中心建設暫時放緩，也不代表AI相關企業未來幾季營收必然下滑。
他認為，原本可用的運算容量可能轉而滿足其他地區的需求，因為算力需求遍及全球，大型雲端業者也正在世界各地興建資料中心。
Prosor並表示，市場可能即將迎來一段時間以來，企業對財報展望與市場預期最為謹慎的財報季，這反而可能為企業實際業績優於預期創造更大空間。
Pilot Wave Holdings合夥人Mark Spindel也指出，上周四市場將AI資本支出、資料中心政策風險、通膨及利率上升等不同疑慮集中反映在同一波交易中；周五的反彈則顯示，投資人開始重新區分這些風險，而非將其視為單一問題。
Spindel強調，晶片需求並未消失，但隨著投資者重新評估AI基礎設施建設的時間表，市場出現「短期波動」在所難免。
此外，《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic截至10月底的年經常性營收（ARR）已超過800億美元，高於9月底的水準，為AI產業需求帶來另一項正面訊號。
不過，報導也指出，部分Anthropic投資人認為，公司原先設定的1.5兆美元IPO估值目標可能需要下修。
儘管晶片股已出現反彈，投資人仍須為後續波動做好準備。Lee提醒，在市場劇烈震盪期間，投資人不宜做出非理性的投資組合調整。
paras_en: US chip stocks, after enduring the most severe sell‑off in six years, staged a strong rebound last Friday (the 6th). However, analysts warn that this bounce mainly reflects investors buying the dip and does not mean concerns over AI data‑center investment prospects have vanished; chip stocks may continue to experience sharp volatility.
According to MarketWatch, at Friday’s close AMD rose 11%, Intel 8%, Micron 5%; Nvidia and Sandisk gained 3% and 4% respectively, while Broadcom edged up less than 1%.
StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee noted that the heavy sell‑off on Thursday (the 5th) created a clear short‑term rebound opportunity for AI‑related chip stocks on Friday.
He said the SOXX semiconductor ETF plunged 12% on Thursday, whereas the iShares Expanded Tech‑Software ETF (IGV), which tracks software stocks, also fell but only about 4%.

Stifel analyst Brian Chin described Friday’s market move as a “sharp volatility reversal.” He believes that although chip stocks rebounded, uncertainty about future data‑center spending will not dissipate quickly and could keep driving price swings in the short term.
Nonetheless, Chin added that the US midterm elections have not altered the fundamental demand for AI; what has become more complex is the regulatory environment for related industries.
After Thursday’s market close, there were some positive developments on data‑center regulation. Texas governor‑elect Gina Hinojosa’s latest remarks were milder than the market had expected.

During her campaign she pledged stricter data‑center regulations, but in a CNN interview on Thursday she said she is not opposed to data centers, only that she wants to pause current projects until safeguards for Texas residents are in place.

J. Gold Associates analyst Jack Gold believes the market over‑reacted to the Democrats’ sweeping election win, with some investors interpreting the result as signaling an end to data‑center construction and expecting a major hit to chip stocks. He notes that politicians in Ohio and New York may also shift their stances.
Gold said the sell‑off was excessive and added that investors are already buying at lower prices.

Deep33 venture‑capital partner Lior Prosor pointed out that even if US data‑center construction temporarily slows, it does not mean AI‑related companies’ revenues will necessarily decline in the coming quarters.
He argues that the available compute capacity could be redirected to other regions, as demand for compute is global and major cloud providers are building data centers worldwide.
Prosor also said the market may be entering a earnings season where companies are most cautious about outlooks versus market expectations, which could actually give firms more room to beat forecasts.

Pilot Wave Holdings partner Mark Spindel noted that on Thursday the market bundled AI capex, data‑center policy risk, inflation and rising rates into a single wave of trading; Friday’s rebound shows investors are beginning to separate these risks rather than treating them as a single issue.
Spindel emphasized that chip demand has not vanished, but as investors reassess the timeline for AI infrastructure build‑out, short‑term volatility is inevitable.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Anthropic’s annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceeded $80 billion as of the end of October, up from the September level, providing another positive signal for AI demand.
The report also noted that some Anthropic investors think the company’s original $1.5 trillion IPO valuation target may need to be revised downward.

Even though chip stocks have rebounded, investors should remain prepared for further swings. Lee cautioned that during periods of sharp market turbulence, investors should avoid making irrational portfolio adjustments.

items.title: Anthropic砸34億美元搶電力！預訂1.7GW燃氣發電機、支應AI資料中心需求
items.title_en: Anthropic Spends $3.4 Billion on Power, Orders 1.7 GW of Gas Generators to Support AI Data Centers
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic持續擴大AI基礎設施布局。據悉，該公司已達成一筆價值約34億美元的交易，用於取得用於資料中心的燃氣發電設備。
根據《金融時報》周日（8日）報導，Anthropic於9月下旬向總部位於美國德州聖安東尼奧的設備供應商OnePWR Solutions達成協議，預訂了總容量達1.7 GW的大型發電機供應，是目前已知AI實驗室單筆規模最大的發電設備採購案。
報導引述知情人士指出，這筆交易並不涉及收購OnePWR本身，該公司也沒有員工轉至Anthropic任職，但Anthropic取得的交易內容包含安裝這批發電機所需的工程及施工能力。
報導另指出，Anthropic最初計畫向OnePWR購買電力，後來則改為接手該公司向美國設備製造商Caterpillar訂購的發電機。
不過，Anthropic與OnePWR目前尚未回應。
《彭博》指出，這筆交易是AI實驗室進一步深入能源產業的最新跡象。在爭相確保稀缺電力設備供應之際，AI業者也開始繞過中間商，直接取得所需資源。
此外，這筆交易也反映出，在長期高度依賴合作夥伴來獲取電力、晶片、資料中心和土地資源之後，Anthropic 正尋求對其 AI 營運背後的基礎設施實現更強的掌控。
《路透》9月曾報導，Anthropic預計未來10年投入超過5,000億美元建設AI基礎設施；《彭博》則報導稱，Anthropic上周曾表示，未來幾年計畫投入超過8,950億美元，其中大部分將用於運算能力成本及基礎設施。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic continues to expand its AI infrastructure footprint. The company has reportedly struck a deal worth about $3.4 billion to acquire gas‑powered generation equipment for its data centers.

According to the Financial Times on Sunday the 8th, Anthropic reached an agreement in late September with OnePWR Solutions, a Texas‑based equipment supplier, to reserve large generators with a total capacity of 1.7 GW – the largest single‑unit power‑equipment purchase known for an AI lab.

The report, citing sources, says the transaction does not involve acquiring OnePWR itself and no OnePWR staff are moving to Anthropic, but the deal includes the engineering and construction services needed to install the generators.
The article also notes that Anthropic originally planned to buy electricity from OnePWR, but later decided to take over the generators that OnePWR had ordered from U.S. equipment maker Caterpillar.
Anthropic and OnePWR have not yet responded to inquiries.

Bloomberg said the deal is the latest sign that AI labs are moving deeper into the energy sector. As firms scramble for scarce power‑equipment, AI players are bypassing intermediaries and securing the resources directly.

The transaction also reflects Anthropic’s shift toward greater control over the infrastructure behind its AI operations after years of relying heavily on partners for power, chips, data‑center space and land.

Reuters reported in September that Anthropic expects to invest more than $500 billion over the next decade in AI infrastructure; Bloomberg said the company last week announced plans to spend over $895 billion in the coming years, most of it on compute costs and infrastructure.

paras: 1.繼國安基金宣布決議進場執行護盤任務後，金管會6日晚間亦祭出限空令，證期局宣布，自9日起調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限，同步調高融券保證金成數，期望透過多項穩定措施，抑制極端空頭炒作，並同步擴大投資人補繳擔保品的管道，全力維護資本市場穩定。
2.台股6日演出史上最大崩跌，重跌近3800點，連續五日收黑，上午行政院長卓榮泰緊急呼籲金管會採取因應措施後，國安基金於下午2點30分召開第131次臨時委員會議。經管理委員會充分討論並達成共識決議，正式授權執行秘書視情況動用資金執行市場安定任務，宣告下周起將發揮護盤救市功效，全力維持資本市場穩定。

4.群聯(8299-TW)6日召開法說會，執行長潘健成表示，AI需求持續升溫，10月AI生態系業務占營收比重已達65%，企業級業務也超過整體營收一半，明年企業級SSD需求可望延續成長。不過，隨著低價庫存逐步消化，長期維持60%以上毛利率並不合理，未來幾季若能維持50%以上，就已相當不錯，更重要是絕對金額要能持續成長。

paras_en: Following the National Security Fund’s announcement that it will carry out a market‑stabilisation mission, the Financial Supervisory Commission on the evening of the 6th issued a short‑selling restriction. The Securities and Futures Bureau said that from September 9 the daily intraday borrowing‑sell order limit will be lowered and the margin requirement for short sales will be raised, aiming to curb extreme short‑selling activity, expand channels for investors to post additional collateral, and fully safeguard market stability.

The Taiwan market on the 6th suffered its biggest crash in history, plunging nearly 3,800 points and posting five consecutive days of losses. After Premier Chou Rong‑tai urgently called on the FSC to act, the National Security Fund convened its 131st emergency committee at 2:30 pm. The management committee discussed the situation thoroughly, reached consensus and formally authorized the secretariat to deploy funds as needed for market‑stabilisation, announcing that from next week it will play a protective role to keep the capital market stable.

Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) and its four “pillars” announced October revenue on the 6th. Benefiting from the peak season of gold in September and silver in October, Formosa Plastics, Nan Ya (1303‑TW) and Taiwan Chemical (1326‑TW) all posted double‑digit year‑over‑year growth, while Formosa Petrochemical (6505‑TW) saw oil‑price‑driven high margins and a 94.8% YoY increase in refinery sales (76% for the month), the best among the four. The group’s total revenue reached NT$163.9 billion, down 1.8% month‑on‑month but up 62.5% YoY. Nan Ya, driven by strong AI‑server demand, saw electronic‑materials revenue exceed 60% of total and recorded a new 55‑month high for the month.

Phison Electronics (8299‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 6th. CEO Pan Chien‑cheng said AI demand remains hot, with AI‑related ecosystem business accounting for 65% of October revenue and enterprise‑grade business exceeding half of total sales. He expects enterprise‑grade SSD demand to keep growing next year. However, as low‑price inventory is gradually cleared, maintaining a gross margin above 60% long‑term is unrealistic; achieving over 50% for the next few quarters would be very good, and the key is to keep absolute revenue growing.

Wiwynn (6669‑TW) reported its latest financial results on the 6th. Net profit after tax for the first three quarters totaled NT$52.448 billion, a 40% YoY increase and a historic high, already surpassing the full‑year profit projected for 2025, with earnings per share of NT$94.04. The board also approved capital injections of US$250 million and US$200 million for its U.S. and Malaysian subsidiaries, respectively.

The Financial Supervisory Commission launches three rescue measures: lower the daily securities‑borrowing sell‑off limit, raise the margin requirement for short sales, and relax the range of acceptable collateral.
Taiwan stocks will be “stable” next week! The National Security Fund held an emergency meeting and decided to intervene to support the market.
Formosa Plastics Group’s Four Pillars results: peak season plus oil prices at six‑month highs drive about 60% YoY revenue growth; Nan Ya posts a new 55‑month high.
Phison earnings call: CEO Pan Chien‑cheng sees enterprise SSD demand rising next year; maintaining a 60% gross margin is unrealistic, focus should be on total revenue growth.
Wiwynn’s Q1‑Q3 profit of NT$52.4 billion tops last year; capital increases of US$250 million and US$200 million for its U.S. and Malaysian subsidiaries.
Winbond outlook: the wafer‑fab leader is rumored to move into 3D DRAM; CEO Chiao Yu‑chun says TSMC pursues excellence and will not settle for half‑measures.
Shipping index: November off‑season sees slower shipments; freight rates on European and trans‑Atlantic lines diverge.
China Steel posted Q3 earnings of NT$0.07 per share and is investing NT$1.079 billion in solid‑oxide fuel cells to support process electrification.
Electronics “Big Five” revenue: Wistron’s revenue for the first ten months reached NT$3.29 trillion, a new high; AI‑server momentum is expected to improve in November and December.
China Airlines Q3 profit rose nearly 50% YoY, marking the third‑highest quarterly profit on record.
Furukawa earnings call: Q3 non‑operating gains turned profit, EPS 1.99 NT$, but AI‑driven displacement leads to a weaker Q4 peak season and a revenue decline.

items.title: 〈走進中國〉多個小城長滿外國人 越來越多外國人來中國買買買
items.title_en: Multiple Small Chinese Towns Filled with Foreigners as More Visitors Come to China to Shop
paras: 隨著中國過境免簽等便利化措施深入實施，越來越多外國遊客來中國旅遊、購物。
中國官方數據顯示，第三季外國人入境達1,160.1萬人次，較一年前增加15.6%；其中免簽入境899.2萬人次，佔77.5%，增長24.1%。
據《第一財經》報導，從空間分布來看，當前入境遊目的地正在從一線城市向中小城市擴展。
其中，在湖南湘西州，湘西州文化旅遊廣電局提供的數據顯示，2025年全州接待入境遊客33.57萬人次、入境遊客總花費1.3億美元，位居湖南省第三；2026年前三季全州入境過夜遊客24.07萬人次，入境遊客總花費超過1億美元。
在湖南省永順縣芙蓉鎮，一座藏在湘西群山間的高鐵站，每天迎來大批外籍旅客。面對外籍旅客日益增多的出行需求，芙蓉鎮站候車室大屏設置中英雙語指引標識，清晰展示車次、檢票、乘車等訊息；站內各個崗位均有智慧翻譯器，方便鐵路工作人員及時解答外籍旅客出行疑問。
張家界早已有「國際張」之稱。過去張家界入境遊高度依賴韓國市場，但2025年迎來結構性突破：韓國仍為第一大客源國，而歐美遊客年增260%，其中法國暴增636%、西班牙723%、義大利915%，客源更多元。
今年上半年，張家界接待入境遊客69.92萬人次，外匯收入7,941.28萬美元。在西班牙、義大利、波蘭等國，每四到五個來華遊客中，就有一人將張家界列入行程。
中國移動梧桐的數據顯示，國慶假期期間，廣西桂林和崇左、湖南張家界和湘潭、新疆烏魯木齊和伊犁的外國遊客人次年增幅均超過50%。
同時，越來越多外國朋友來華「買買買」，「空箱來，滿箱走」。在北上廣深重點商圈，外國遊客的「濃度」越來越高。
今年1～8月，全中國重點商圈外國遊客量較一年前驟增38%，上海淮海中路、上海外灘、深圳龍華、北京三里屯、廣州天河路等成為外國遊客最愛打卡商圈，來華「買買買」成為重要旅行體驗。
在廣州市海珠區萬國奧特萊斯，隨處可見外國人在此購物。海珠區萬國奧特萊斯商場正式成為離境退稅「即買即退」常態化集中退付點。萬國奧特萊斯的折扣衣服、鞋帽產品，吸引不少外國人前來購買。
浙江義烏國際商貿城人氣持續火爆，大批海外客商與遊客慕名前來淘選好物。各國遊客在市場既能一站式採購，也能體驗AI定制、智慧潮玩等新型消費，在購物過程中感受中國製造的活力。
paras_en: As China implements facilitative measures such as transit visa‑free entry, an increasing number of foreign tourists are traveling to China for sightseeing and shopping.

Official Chinese data show that foreign arrivals in the third quarter reached 11.601 million person‑visits, a 15.6% increase year‑on‑year; of these, 8.992 million were visa‑free entries, accounting for 77.5% and up 24.1% from the previous year.
According to First Financial, the geographic distribution of inbound tourism is shifting from first‑tier cities toward medium‑ and small‑size cities.

In Xiangxi Prefecture of Hunan Province, the local Culture, Tourism and Broadcasting Bureau reports that the region expects to host 335,700 inbound tourists in 2025, generating US$130 million in total spending, ranking third in Hunan; in the first three quarters of 2026 the prefecture recorded 240,700 overnight inbound visitors with total spending exceeding US$100 million.

In Furong Town, Yongshun County, Hunan, a high‑speed rail station hidden among the Xiangxi mountains welcomes large numbers of foreign travelers each day. To meet growing demand, the station’s waiting‑room screens display bilingual Chinese‑English signage for train schedules, ticket checks and boarding information, and every service desk is equipped with smart translators to help railway staff answer visitors’ questions promptly.

Zhangjiajie has long been known as “International Zhang.” Historically its inbound tourism relied heavily on the Korean market, but 2025 marked a structural breakthrough: Korea remains the top source, while European and American visitors grew 260% year‑on‑year, with France up 636%, Spain 723% and Italy 915%, diversifying the visitor base.

In the first half of this year, Zhangjiajie received 699,200 inbound tourists, generating foreign‑exchange earnings of US$79.4128 million. In markets such as Spain, Italy and Poland, roughly one in every four to five Chinese‑bound tourists includes Zhangjiajie in their itinerary.

Data from China Mobile’s Wutong platform show that during the National Day holiday, foreign‑visitor growth rates exceeded 50% in Guangxi’s Guilin and Chongzuo, Hunan’s Zhangjiajie and Xiangtan, and Xinjiang’s Urumqi and Ili regions.

At the same time, more foreign friends are coming to China to “shop, shop, shop,” arriving with empty suitcases and leaving with them full. In the major commercial districts of Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen, the concentration of foreign shoppers is steadily rising.

From January to August this year, foreign visitor traffic in China’s key shopping districts jumped 38% compared with a year earlier. Areas such as Shanghai’s Huaihai Road, the Bund, Shenzhen’s Longhua, Beijing’s Sanlitun and Guangzhou’s Tianhe Road have become the most popular check‑in spots for overseas shoppers, making “shopping sprees” a key part of their travel experience.

In the Wan Guo Outlet Mall in Haizhu District, Guangzhou, foreign shoppers are a common sight. The mall has become a regular, centralized point for “buy‑now‑tax‑refund‑now” services for departing visitors. Discounted apparel, shoes and accessories attract many foreigners looking to purchase goods at reduced prices.

Yiwu International Trade City in Zhejiang continues to draw huge crowds, with many overseas merchants and tourists coming to select quality products. Visitors can shop in a one‑stop market while experiencing AI‑customized items and smart trendy toys, feeling the vitality of Made‑in‑China consumption.

items.title: 八貫10月受軍工產品 年增290％亮眼佳績 單月營收年增53％創同期新高
items.title_en: Baguang Posts Impressive October Results with Military Products Up 290% YoY, Monthly Revenue Up 53% to Record High
paras: TPU(熱熱塑性聚氨酯)機能布料廠八貫(1342-TW)公告10月營收2.88億元，月減3.68％、年增53.88％，累計今(2026)年前10月營收為31.4億元、年增率達37.5％。
八貫表示，今年10月因台灣適逢2個連續假期，加上颱風擾局，致製造實質工作與出貨天數減少，單月營收月減4％。但因醫療與軍工產品10月營收較上(9)月分別成長8％與66％，與航太航海維持穩健出貨而受益。
八貫指出，10月營收較去年同期仍維持強勁成長，年增53.9％，係四大產品10月營收較去年同期均維持雙位數成長，其中軍工產品10月營收年增290％，成長動能最為突出。
八貫表示，四大產品線累計前10月年增與占比均維持雙位數成長與比重依序為戶外、醫療與航海航太產品，雖軍工產品於營收低基期基礎，但累計前10月營收年增仍達35％。
展望第四季，八貫表示，因歐美品牌客戶因應聖誕節與年底假期等節慶採購季節，將推升終端備貨與拉貨力道，公司將持續優化產線降低營業成本，以期推升第4季毛利率表現，力拼全年獲利續登峰。
八貫受惠於機能性布料產品及其相關成品組件之二次及三次製造加工及銷售，終端應用於高端醫療、航太、救生、戶外用等產業，多數產品仍需要通過認證後出貨產品。
paras_en: Baguang (1342-TW), a TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) functional fabric manufacturer, announced October revenue of NT$288 million, down 3.68% month‑on‑month but up 53.88% year‑on‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first ten months of 2026 reached NT$3.14 billion, a 37.5% increase over the same period last year.

The company said October’s slight month‑over‑month decline was due to two consecutive public holidays in Taiwan and a typhoon that reduced actual production and shipping days, cutting monthly revenue by about 4%. However, revenue from medical and military products grew 8% and 66% respectively from September, and steady shipments of aerospace and marine products also helped.

Baguang noted that October revenue still showed strong growth compared with the same month last year, up 53.9% year‑on‑year. All four major product categories posted double‑digit growth in October, with military product revenue soaring 290% year‑on‑year, the most pronounced growth driver.

The firm said that for the first ten months, each of the four product lines posted double‑digit year‑over‑year growth and contributed proportionally, led by outdoor, medical and marine‑aerospace products. Although military products started from a low base, cumulative revenue for the first ten months still rose 35% year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead to Q4, Baguang expects that European and American brand customers will increase end‑user stocking and pull‑forward orders in response to the Christmas and year‑end holiday buying season. The company will continue to optimise its production lines to lower operating costs, aiming to boost Q4 gross‑margin performance and push full‑year profit to new heights.

Baguang benefits from secondary and tertiary manufacturing and sales of functional fabric products and related components, which are used in high‑end medical, aerospace, rescue, and outdoor applications. Most of these products still require certification before shipment.

items.title: 史上最大GPU竊盜案！加州奧克蘭發生特大貨運搶劫案　價值1140萬美元輝達硬體失蹤
items.title_en: Largest GPU Theft in History! Massive Cargo Heist in Oakland, California—$11.4 Million Worth of NVIDIA Hardware Vanishes
paras: 美國加州奧克蘭近期發生一起精心策劃的貨運竊盜案，一批價值1140萬美元的輝達貨物在運輸途中離奇失踪，被多家媒體稱為「史上最大GPU竊盜案」。
調查顯示，一輛裝載輝達貨物的卡車於今年8月29日從加州奧克蘭出發，原定運往德州沃思堡，取貨流程符合原定安排，但卡車最終失聯，受害者9月13日向警方報案。該批貨物共六個托盤。
美國加州奧克蘭市警方正進行調查，被竊物品為AI晶片和電腦硬件，價值高達1140萬美元。分析師表示，這可能是一起針對高科技企業精心策劃的竊盜案。
警方追蹤發現，卡車曾在途中多次停靠，單次停留時長達數小時，最終在加州東南部聖貝納迪諾縣失去蹤跡。截至目前，警方尚未逮捕任何嫌疑人。
據悉，這並非輝達首次遭遇貨物被盜事件，且是目前已知單筆案值最高的輝達單車貨運失竊事件。近年來美國高價值科技貨品劫案頻傳，先前加州就有多起針對輝達貨物的竊盜案件。
柏克萊加州大學分校教授Olaf J. Groth分析，輝達AI晶片市場需求旺盛，海外售價約為美國本土兩倍，巨大的利潤空間催生犯罪動機。本次案件佈局周密，也反映出竊案集團持續走向職業化。
paras_en: A meticulously planned cargo theft recently occurred in Oakland, California, where a shipment worth $11.4 million in NVIDIA goods mysteriously disappeared en route, being dubbed by multiple media outlets as the "largest GPU theft in history."

Investigators say a truck carrying the NVIDIA cargo left Oakland on August 29 and was slated for Fort Worth, Texas. The pickup process followed the scheduled plan, but the truck later went missing, prompting the victim to file a police report on September 13. The shipment consisted of six pallets.

Oakland police are investigating the case; the stolen items include AI chips and computer hardware valued at up to $11.4 million. Analysts suggest the theft appears to be a carefully orchestrated operation targeting a high‑tech company.

Police tracking shows the truck made several stops along the way, some lasting several hours, and ultimately vanished in San Bernardino County in southeastern California. No suspects have been arrested so far.

This is not the first time NVIDIA has suffered a cargo theft, and it is currently the single highest‑value incident known for a stolen NVIDIA shipment. In recent years, high‑value tech cargo robberies have become frequent in the U.S., with several prior thefts of NVIDIA goods reported in California.

Professor Olaf J. Groth of the University of California, Berkeley, notes that demand for NVIDIA AI chips is strong, with overseas prices roughly twice those in the United States, creating huge profit margins that fuel criminal motives. The sophisticated planning of this case also reflects the growing professionalization of theft groups.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉華星光Q3獲利創單季新高 外資連5買先行布局
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Hua Xing Guang Q3 Profit Hits Quarterly Record; Foreign Investors Buy Over 5 Consecutive Days to Build Positions
paras: 光通訊廠華星光(4979-TW)上周自結今(2026)年第3季財報，單季稅後純益為3.25億元，季增76.6%、年增49.5%，EPS為2.28元，創單季歷史新高，在大盤盤勢重挫一周下，外資仍看好華星光未來業績向上，連續5天共買超6,646張先行布局。
華星光第3季合併營收為16.29億元、季增26.4％、年增51.4％，稅後純益3.25億元、季增76.6％；毛利率為27.2%、季增4.8個百分點、年增6.1個百分點。
累計前3季合併營收達41.12億元、年增27.3％，平均毛利率25.2％、年增4.9個百分點，稅後純益7.39億元、年增40.6％，單季與前3季獲利雙雙創歷史同期新高，每股純益累計為5.19元。
/法人表示，華星光近期股價自上(10)月中旬588元高點，因整體市場回檔，股價下挫至300元附近，跌幅較深，目前短中期均線面臨下彎壓力，日成交量也從高峰萎縮，提醒股價在340元附近，有機會成為近期股價支撐區，投資人需留意短線量能續航不足與技術修正風險。
華星光今年受惠於光通訊大廠委外訂單持續增加，推動CW Laser產品線代工需求增加，加上華星光逐季拉高無塵室空間、進而推動產能提升，使華星光產量也同步成長，且目前訂單能見度幾乎可望放眼到明年上半年，使華星光今、明(2027)年營運都可望再度攻高。
法人表示，華星光今年雖受惠於AI伺服器與資料中心升級潮亮眼，營運迎來強勁成長動能，但從產品組合與毛利率結構細看，後續要推動華星光獲利結構真正獲得改善，關鍵仍在於高毛利的晶片與加工業務的占比提升。
paras_en: Optoelectronics manufacturer Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW) released its Q3 2026 financial results last week, reporting a quarterly net profit after tax of NT$325 million, up 76.6% sequentially and 49.5% year‑over‑year. EPS was NT$2.28, a historic quarterly high. Despite a sharp market decline over the week, foreign investors remained bullish, buying a total of 6,646 lots over five consecutive days to get ahead of the stock.

In Q3, Hua Xing Guang’s consolidated revenue reached NT$1.629 billion, up 26.4% sequentially and 51.4% year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$325 million, a 76.6% sequential increase. The gross margin stood at 27.2%, up 4.8 percentage points sequentially and 6.1 points year‑over‑year.

Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters totaled NT$4.112 billion, a 27.3% year‑over‑year rise. The average gross margin was 25.2%, up 4.9 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax reached NT$739 million, up 40.6% year‑over‑year. Both the quarterly and the first‑three‑quarter profits set new historical highs for the same periods, with cumulative EPS of NT$5.19.

Institutional investors note that Hua Xing Guang’s share price fell from a mid‑October high of NT$588 to around NT$300 amid a broader market pullback, a steep decline. The short‑ and medium‑term moving averages are now under downward pressure and daily trading volume has contracted from its peak. They point out that the price level near NT$340 could act as a near‑term support zone, and investors should watch for insufficient short‑term volume and technical correction risks.

Hua Xing Guang has benefited this year from increasing outsourced orders from major optical‑communication manufacturers, driving higher demand for its CW laser product line. The company has also been expanding clean‑room space quarter by quarter, boosting capacity and output. Order visibility now extends almost to the first half of next year, allowing the firm to target another performance upswing in 2026 and 2027.

Analysts say that while Hua Xing Guang has enjoyed strong growth this year thanks to the AI server and data‑center upgrade wave, a deeper look at its product mix and margin structure shows that sustainable profit improvement will depend on raising the share of high‑margin chip and processing businesses in its portfolio.

items.title: 〈台股盤前要聞〉金管會祭限空令、國安基金本周進場護盤、台塑四寶10月營收全面翻紅
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Pre‑Market News: Financial Supervisory Commission Issues Short‑Selling Ban, National Security Fund to Intervene This Week, Formosa Plastics Group’s Four Pillars See October Revenue Turn Positive
paras: 1.繼國安基金宣布決議進場執行護盤任務後，金管會6日晚間亦祭出限空令，證期局宣布，自9日起調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限，同步調高融券保證金成數，期望透過多項穩定措施，抑制極端空頭炒作，並同步擴大投資人補繳擔保品的管道，全力維護資本市場穩定。
2.台股6日演出史上最大崩跌，重跌近3800點，連續五日收黑，上午行政院長卓榮泰緊急呼籲金管會採取因應措施後，國安基金於下午2點30分召開第131次臨時委員會議。經管理委員會充分討論並達成共識決議，正式授權執行秘書視情況動用資金執行市場安定任務，宣告下周起將發揮護盤救市功效，全力維持資本市場穩定。

paras_en: Following the National Security Fund’s announcement that it will carry out a market‑stabilisation mission, the Financial Supervisory Commission on the evening of the 6th issued a short‑selling restriction. The Securities and Futures Bureau said that from September 9 the daily intraday borrowing‑sell order limit will be lowered and the margin requirement for short sales will be raised, aiming to curb extreme short‑selling activity, expand channels for investors to post additional collateral, and fully safeguard market stability.

The Taiwan market on the 6th suffered its biggest crash in history, plunging nearly 3,800 points and posting five consecutive days of losses. After Premier Chou Rong‑tai urgently called on the FSC to act, the National Security Fund convened its 131st emergency committee at 2:30 pm. The management committee discussed the situation thoroughly, reached consensus and formally authorized the secretariat to deploy funds as needed for market‑stabilisation, announcing that from next week it will play a protective role to keep the capital market stable.

Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) and its four “pillars” announced October revenue on the 6th. Benefiting from the peak season of gold in September and silver in October, Formosa Plastics, Nan Ya (1303‑TW) and Taiwan Chemical (1326‑TW) all posted double‑digit year‑over‑year growth, while Formosa Petrochemical (6505‑TW) saw oil‑price‑driven high margins and a 94.8% YoY increase in refinery sales (76% for the month), the best among the four. The group’s total revenue reached NT$163.9 billion, down 1.8% month‑on‑month but up 62.5% YoY. Nan Ya, driven by strong AI‑server demand, saw electronic‑materials revenue exceed 60% of total and recorded a new 55‑month high for the month.

Phison Electronics (8299‑TW) held its earnings briefing on the 6th. CEO Pan Chien‑cheng said AI demand remains hot, with AI‑related ecosystem business accounting for 65% of October revenue and enterprise‑grade business exceeding half of total sales. He expects enterprise‑grade SSD demand to keep growing next year. However, as low‑price inventory is gradually cleared, maintaining a gross margin above 60% long‑term is unrealistic; achieving over 50% for the next few quarters would be very good, and the key is to keep absolute revenue growing.

Wiwynn (6669‑TW) reported its latest financial results on the 6th. Net profit after tax for the first three quarters totaled NT$52.448 billion, a 40% YoY increase and a historic high, already surpassing the full‑year profit projected for 2025, with earnings per share of NT$94.04. The board also approved capital injections of US$250 million and US$200 million for its U.S. and Malaysian subsidiaries, respectively.

The Financial Supervisory Commission launches three rescue measures: lower the daily securities‑borrowing sell‑off limit, raise the margin requirement for short sales, and relax the range of acceptable collateral.
Taiwan stocks will be “stable” next week! The National Security Fund held an emergency meeting and decided to intervene to support the market.
Formosa Plastics Group’s Four Pillars results: peak season plus oil prices at six‑month highs drive about 60% YoY revenue growth; Nan Ya posts a new 55‑month high.
Phison earnings call: CEO Pan Chien‑cheng sees enterprise SSD demand rising next year; maintaining a 60% gross margin is unrealistic, focus should be on total revenue growth.
Wiwynn’s Q1‑Q3 profit of NT$52.4 billion tops last year; capital increases of US$250 million and US$200 million for its U.S. and Malaysian subsidiaries.
Winbond outlook: the wafer‑fab leader is rumored to move into 3D DRAM; CEO Chiao Yu‑chun says TSMC pursues excellence and will not settle for half‑measures.
Shipping index: November off‑season sees slower shipments; freight rates on European and trans‑Atlantic lines diverge.
China Steel posted Q3 earnings of NT$0.07 per share and is investing NT$1.079 billion in solid‑oxide fuel cells to support process electrification.
Electronics “Big Five” revenue: Wistron’s revenue for the first ten months reached NT$3.29 trillion, a new high; AI‑server momentum is expected to improve in November and December.
China Airlines Q3 profit rose nearly 50% YoY, marking the third‑highest quarterly profit on record.
Furukawa earnings call: Q3 non‑operating gains turned profit, EPS 1.99 NT$, but AI‑driven displacement leads to a weaker Q4 peak season and a revenue decline.

items.title_en: Baguang Posts Impressive October Results with Military Products Up 290% YoY, Monthly Revenue Up 53% to Record High
paras: TPU(熱熱塑性聚氨酯)機能布料廠八貫(1342-TW)公告10月營收2.88億元，月減3.68％、年增53.88％，累計今(2026)年前10月營收為31.4億元、年增率達37.5％。
八貫表示，今年10月因台灣適逢2個連續假期，加上颱風擾局，致製造實質工作與出貨天數減少，單月營收月減4％。但因醫療與軍工產品10月營收較上(9)月分別成長8％與66％，與航太航海維持穩健出貨而受益。
八貫指出，10月營收較去年同期仍維持強勁成長，年增53.9％，係四大產品10月營收較去年同期均維持雙位數成長，其中軍工產品10月營收年增290％，成長動能最為突出。
八貫表示，四大產品線累計前10月年增與占比均維持雙位數成長與比重依序為戶外、醫療與航海航太產品，雖軍工產品於營收低基期基礎，但累計前10月營收年增仍達35％。
展望第四季，八貫表示，因歐美品牌客戶因應聖誕節與年底假期等節慶採購季節，將推升終端備貨與拉貨力道，公司將持續優化產線降低營業成本，以期推升第4季毛利率表現，力拼全年獲利續登峰。
八貫受惠於機能性布料產品及其相關成品組件之二次及三次製造加工及銷售，終端應用於高端醫療、航太、救生、戶外用等產業，多數產品仍需要通過認證後出貨產品。
paras_en: Baguang (1342-TW), a TPU (thermoplastic polyurethane) functional fabric manufacturer, announced October revenue of NT$288 million, down 3.68% month‑on‑month but up 53.88% year‑on‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first ten months of 2026 reached NT$3.14 billion, a 37.5% increase over the same period last year.

The company said October’s slight month‑over‑month decline was due to two consecutive public holidays in Taiwan and a typhoon that reduced actual production and shipping days, cutting monthly revenue by about 4%. However, revenue from medical and military products grew 8% and 66% respectively from September, and steady shipments of aerospace and marine products also helped.

Baguang noted that October revenue still showed strong growth compared with the same month last year, up 53.9% year‑on‑year. All four major product categories posted double‑digit growth in October, with military product revenue soaring 290% year‑on‑year, the most pronounced growth driver.

The firm said that for the first ten months, each of the four product lines posted double‑digit year‑over‑year growth and contributed proportionally, led by outdoor, medical and marine‑aerospace products. Although military products started from a low base, cumulative revenue for the first ten months still rose 35% year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead to Q4, Baguang expects that European and American brand customers will increase end‑user stocking and pull‑forward orders in response to the Christmas and year‑end holiday buying season. The company will continue to optimise its production lines to lower operating costs, aiming to boost Q4 gross‑margin performance and push full‑year profit to new heights.

Baguang benefits from secondary and tertiary manufacturing and sales of functional fabric products and related components, which are used in high‑end medical, aerospace, rescue, and outdoor applications. Most of these products still require certification before shipment.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉華星光Q3獲利創單季新高 外資連5買先行布局
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Hua Xing Guang Q3 Profit Hits Quarterly Record; Foreign Investors Buy Over 5 Consecutive Days to Build Positions
paras: 光通訊廠華星光(4979-TW)上周自結今(2026)年第3季財報，單季稅後純益為3.25億元，季增76.6%、年增49.5%，EPS為2.28元，創單季歷史新高，在大盤盤勢重挫一周下，外資仍看好華星光未來業績向上，連續5天共買超6,646張先行布局。
華星光第3季合併營收為16.29億元、季增26.4％、年增51.4％，稅後純益3.25億元、季增76.6％；毛利率為27.2%、季增4.8個百分點、年增6.1個百分點。
累計前3季合併營收達41.12億元、年增27.3％，平均毛利率25.2％、年增4.9個百分點，稅後純益7.39億元、年增40.6％，單季與前3季獲利雙雙創歷史同期新高，每股純益累計為5.19元。
/法人表示，華星光近期股價自上(10)月中旬588元高點，因整體市場回檔，股價下挫至300元附近，跌幅較深，目前短中期均線面臨下彎壓力，日成交量也從高峰萎縮，提醒股價在340元附近，有機會成為近期股價支撐區，投資人需留意短線量能續航不足與技術修正風險。
華星光今年受惠於光通訊大廠委外訂單持續增加，推動CW Laser產品線代工需求增加，加上華星光逐季拉高無塵室空間、進而推動產能提升，使華星光產量也同步成長，且目前訂單能見度幾乎可望放眼到明年上半年，使華星光今、明(2027)年營運都可望再度攻高。
法人表示，華星光今年雖受惠於AI伺服器與資料中心升級潮亮眼，營運迎來強勁成長動能，但從產品組合與毛利率結構細看，後續要推動華星光獲利結構真正獲得改善，關鍵仍在於高毛利的晶片與加工業務的占比提升。
paras_en: Optoelectronics manufacturer Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW) released its Q3 2026 financial results last week, reporting a quarterly net profit after tax of NT$325 million, up 76.6% sequentially and 49.5% year‑over‑year. EPS was NT$2.28, a historic quarterly high. Despite a sharp market decline over the week, foreign investors remained bullish, buying a total of 6,646 lots over five consecutive days to get ahead of the stock.

In Q3, Hua Xing Guang’s consolidated revenue reached NT$1.629 billion, up 26.4% sequentially and 51.4% year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$325 million, a 76.6% sequential increase. The gross margin stood at 27.2%, up 4.8 percentage points sequentially and 6.1 points year‑over‑year.

Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters totaled NT$4.112 billion, a 27.3% year‑over‑year rise. The average gross margin was 25.2%, up 4.9 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax reached NT$739 million, up 40.6% year‑over‑year. Both the quarterly and the first‑three‑quarter profits set new historical highs for the same periods, with cumulative EPS of NT$5.19.

Institutional investors note that Hua Xing Guang’s share price fell from a mid‑October high of NT$588 to around NT$300 amid a broader market pullback, a steep decline. The short‑ and medium‑term moving averages are now under downward pressure and daily trading volume has contracted from its peak. They point out that the price level near NT$340 could act as a near‑term support zone, and investors should watch for insufficient short‑term volume and technical correction risks.

Hua Xing Guang has benefited this year from increasing outsourced orders from major optical‑communication manufacturers, driving higher demand for its CW laser product line. The company has also been expanding clean‑room space quarter by quarter, boosting capacity and output. Order visibility now extends almost to the first half of next year, allowing the firm to target another performance upswing in 2026 and 2027.

Analysts say that while Hua Xing Guang has enjoyed strong growth this year thanks to the AI server and data‑center upgrade wave, a deeper look at its product mix and margin structure shows that sustainable profit improvement will depend on raising the share of high‑margin chip and processing businesses in its portfolio.

items.title: 鴻海參展TASTI 2026 攜集團夥伴展現低軌衛星端到端布局
items.title_en: Foxconn Showcases End-to-End Low‑Earth Orbit Satellite Strategy at TASTI 2026
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)宣布自11月8日至10日參與2026台灣太空國際年會(TASTI 2026)，以「新世代衛星通訊」為主軸，展示第二代珍珠號低軌衛星模型，以及攜手集團夥伴展示衛星通訊模組、陣列式天線、低軌衛星使用者終端及關鍵線材等技術，從單星在軌驗證邁向雙星協同通訊，並進一步布局太空運算及新世代太空基礎設施。
第二代珍珠號PEARL-1A、PEARL-1B於台北時間今年5月3日搭乘SpaceX獵鷹9號(Falcon 9)運載火箭升空，進入距地表約600公里的預定軌道；兩顆衛星延續第一代珍珠號的6U XL架構，單顆重量約9.5公斤，主要執行通訊與太空科學領域的酬載技術驗證，預計在軌執行為期5年的任務。
鴻海研究院新世代通訊研究所所長吳仁銘表示，第二代珍珠號雙星成功進入預定軌道，代表鴻海衛星技術從第一代單星系統驗證，進一步朝雙星協同通訊與太空科學任務發展。透過星間鏈路、電離層觀測及衛星對地寬頻通訊等在軌實驗，將持續累積自主衛星的飛行履歷與實務經驗，並轉化為可延伸、可整合的產業能力。
相較第一代珍珠號著重衛星與地面站之間的寬頻通訊實驗及系統驗證，第二代珍珠號進一步搭載Ka頻段星間鏈路(ISL)酬載，除可進行衛星與地面站之間的寬頻通訊，也將驗證雙星之間的資料傳輸能力。此外，第二代珍珠號也搭載小型電離層探測儀及太陽能電池酬載，進行太空環境觀測與科學實驗，累積衛星設計、系統整合、在軌操作及任務管理經驗。
除衛星平台外，鴻海此次也整合集團通訊技術、硬體設計及系統整合能力，展出多項衛星通訊相關產品。其中，5G地面網路／非地面網路使用者終端數據機模組(5G TN/NTN UT Modem Module)採用聯發科(2454-TW)5G通訊晶片，結合鴻海硬體設計與系統整合能力，布局5G NTN低軌衛星通訊應用。
陣列式天線模組(Phased Array Module)則透過RF高頻波束成形技術，提升低軌衛星通訊效能；RF升降頻模組(RF Up/Down Converter Module)採模組化設計，可相容不同世代類比數據機，展現鴻海從通訊模組、射頻、天線到系統整合的技術布局。
展望未來太空運算及AI應用，鴻海表示，持續發揮在AI、運算、通訊、關鍵零組件、精密製造、系統整合及先進熱管理等領域的優勢，並針對高效散熱與熱傳導等關鍵課題展開早期研究，為AI資料中心技術延伸至衛星及太空運算場景預作準備。也將深化產官學研及國際夥伴合作，逐步建構新世代太空通訊與太空基礎設施所需的技術能力，進一步延伸至太空運算的發展機會。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced that it will participate in the 2026 Taiwan Space International Conference (TASTI 2026) from November 8‑10, focusing on “next‑generation satellite communications.” The company will display a second‑generation Pearl low‑Earth‑orbit satellite model and, together with group partners, demonstrate satellite‑communication modules, phased‑array antennas, LEO user terminals and key cabling technologies, moving from single‑satellite on‑orbit validation to dual‑satellite coordinated communications, and further laying the groundwork for space computing and next‑generation space infrastructure.

The second‑generation Pearl satellites PEARL‑1A and PEARL‑1B were launched on May 3 this year (Taipei time) aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, reaching a planned orbit about 600 km above Earth. Both satellites retain the first‑generation Pearl’s 6U XL bus, weigh roughly 9.5 kg each, and will conduct communications and space‑science payload technology demonstrations, with a planned five‑year on‑orbit mission.

Wu Ren‑ming, director of the New‑Generation Communications Institute at Foxconn Research Center, said the successful insertion of the dual‑satellite second‑generation Pearl into its intended orbit shows Foxconn’s satellite technology has progressed from first‑generation single‑satellite verification to dual‑satellite coordinated communications and space‑science missions. Through on‑orbit experiments such as inter‑satellite links, ionospheric observations and broadband satellite‑to‑ground communications, Foxconn will continue to build flight heritage and practical experience for its autonomous satellites, converting them into extensible, integrated industry capabilities.

Compared with the first‑generation Pearl, which focused on broadband communications experiments and system verification between a satellite and a ground station, the second‑generation Pearl adds a Ka‑band inter‑satellite link (ISL) payload. In addition to broadband satellite‑to‑ground communications, it will also validate data‑transfer capability between the two satellites. Moreover, the new Pearl carries a small ionospheric probe and a solar‑cell payload for space‑environment monitoring and scientific experiments, further accumulating experience in satellite design, system integration, on‑orbit operation and mission management.

Beyond the satellite platform, Foxconn also integrated the group’s communications technology, hardware design and system‑integration expertise to showcase several satellite‑communication products. The 5G ground‑network/non‑ground‑network user‑terminal modem module (5G TN/NTN UT Modem Module) uses MediaTek’s (2454‑TW) 5G chip, combined with Foxconn’s hardware design and system‑integration capabilities to position itself for 5G NTN low‑Earth‑orbit satellite communication applications.

The phased‑array antenna module employs RF high‑frequency beam‑forming technology to boost LEO satellite communication performance. The RF up/down‑converter module uses a modular design that can be compatible with different generations of analog modems, illustrating Foxconn’s technology stack from communication modules and RF to antennas and system integration.

Looking ahead to space computing and AI applications, Foxconn said it will continue to leverage its strengths in AI, computing, communications, critical components, precision manufacturing, system integration and advanced thermal management, and will launch early‑stage research on high‑efficiency heat dissipation and thermal conduction. This prepares the company to extend AI data‑center technologies to satellite and space‑computing scenarios. Foxconn will also deepen collaboration with governments, academia, research institutes and international partners to gradually build the technical capabilities needed for next‑generation space communications and infrastructure, and to further expand into space‑computing opportunities.

items.title: 志聖營收重登10億元大關 10月營收10.13億元創同期新高年增80%
items.title_en: Zhi Sheng's Revenue Reclaims the NT$10 Billion Milestone; October Revenue Hits NT$10.13 Billion, a New Period High, Up 80% YoY
paras: 2026年前3季已賺回逾一個股本季台積電(2330-TW)供應鏈設備廠志聖(2467-TW)今(8)日公布最新營收資訊，志聖2026年10月營收重登10億元大關達10.13億元，歷史同期新高，月增7.21%，年增80.68%，2026年1-10月營收爲90.36億元，年增83.8%。
志聖2026年最新財報，1-9月營收爲80.23億元，年增84.2%，稅後純益16.61億元，年增1.91倍，每股純益已達10.67元。
志聖因應客戶全球擴產，志聖2026年進一步強化美國在地服務據點，並布局馬來西亞與新加坡東南亞平台，讓設備與服務能力貼近客戶。同時導入數位孿生（Digital Twin），將60年製程經驗轉化為可累積、重複運用的數位資產，推動設備開發由可視化、數據化走向物理模擬與AI應用。
同時，志聖表示，AI晶片封裝與高階PCB結構日益複雜，製程潔淨度、熱應力控制及量產良率成為關鍵。志聖推出自動壓膜、無吹氣自動撕膜、壓力烤箱及智慧無塵烤箱，展現材料處理、精準溫壓控制及自動化整合能力，協助客戶因應下一代製程需求。
志聖並表示，下一階段將以「支援AI製造，也應用AI」為發展方向，深化先進封裝與先進PCB布局。
由志聖、均豪精密(5443-TW)、均華精密(6640-TW))與東捷科技(8064-TW))組成的G2C+策略聯盟，其 AI 智慧製造與全球市場的布局。東捷已於2026年4月正式加入G2C+，其營運據點進一步串起台灣西部科技廊道沿線，使聯盟更貼近主要半導體產業聚落與客戶需求，也象徵G2C+從三家創始公司的合作基礎，邁向更完整的設備生態系。
志聖股價6日收盤價報304.5元，較前一昨日下跌33.5元或9.91%，成交量萎縮爲1064張。
設備廠陸續公布最新營收，牧德科技(3563-TW)2026年10月營收4.03 億元，月增 8.19% 、年增 95.59%，單月營收衝破4億大關且續創歷史新高，展現公司營運動能穩定，2026年1-10月營收爲34.08億元，己超越2025年全年營收，年增24.59%。
牧德估2026年第四季將成為公司2026年營運表現最旺的一季。
而也屬台積電供應鏈設備大廠迅得(6438-TW)營收在半導體業務推進一如預期，10 月營收維持在 6 億元以上高檔，以 6.73億元改寫歷史單月次高，也創同期新高，月減3.15%、年增28.08%；累計 2026 年 1-10 月營收達61.86億元，年增 10.93%。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company's (TSMC, 2330‑TW) supply‑chain equipment maker Zhi Sheng (2467‑TW) has already recouped more than one full year of earnings. Today (Oct. 8) the company announced its latest revenue figures: October 2026 revenue climbed back above the NT$10 billion mark to NT$10.13 billion, a historic high for the month, up 7.21% month‑over‑month and 80.68% year‑over‑year. For the January‑October period, revenue reached NT$90.36 billion, an 83.8% increase year‑over‑year.

Zhi Sheng's most recent financial report shows that revenue for January‑September 2026 was NT$80.23 billion, up 84.2% year‑over‑year, with after‑tax net profit of NT$16.61 billion, a 1.91‑times increase year‑over‑year. Earnings per share rose to NT$10.67.

To meet customers' global capacity expansions, Zhi Sheng further strengthened its on‑site service presence in the United States in 2026 and established platforms in Malaysia and Singapore to bring equipment and services closer to clients. The company also introduced Digital Twin technology, converting 60 years of process experience into cumulative, reusable digital assets, advancing equipment development from visualization and data‑driven approaches to physical simulation and AI applications.

Zhi Sheng added that AI chip packaging and advanced PCB structures are becoming increasingly complex, making process cleanliness, thermal‑stress control, and mass‑production yield critical. The firm launched automated lamination, blow‑free automatic film stripping, pressure ovens, and smart clean‑room ovens, showcasing capabilities in material handling, precise temperature‑pressure control, and automation integration to help customers meet next‑generation process demands.
The company further stated that its next development phase will focus on "supporting AI manufacturing while applying AI," deepening its layout in advanced packaging and advanced PCBs.

The G2C+ strategic alliance, composed of Zhi Sheng, Junhao Precision (5443‑TW), Junhua Precision (6640‑TW) and Dongjie Technology (8064‑TW), coordinates AI‑driven smart manufacturing and global market deployment. Dongjie officially joined G2C+ in April 2026, extending the alliance’s operational nodes along Taiwan’s western technology corridor, bringing the group closer to major semiconductor clusters and customer needs, and marking G2C+’s evolution from a three‑founder base to a more complete equipment ecosystem.
Zhi Sheng's stock closed at NT$304.5 on the 6th, down NT$33.5 or 9.91% from the previous session, with trading volume shrinking to 1,064 lots.

Equipment makers have been steadily reporting new revenues. Mu De Technology (3563‑TW) posted October 2026 revenue of NT$4.03 billion, up 8.19% month‑over‑month and 95.59% year‑over‑year, breaking the NT$4 billion threshold for the first time and setting a new historical high. For the January‑October period, its revenue reached NT$34.08 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 fiscal year and rising 24.59% year‑over‑year.
Mu De estimates that the fourth quarter of 2026 will be the strongest quarter for the company's overall performance that year.

Another major TSMC supply‑chain equipment supplier, Xun De (6438‑TW), saw semiconductor business progress as expected. October revenue stayed above NT$600 million, reaching a record‑high NT$673 million for a single month, also a new period high, down 3.15% month‑over‑month but up 28.08% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for January‑October 2026 totaled NT$6.186 billion, a 10.93% increase year‑over‑year.

items.title: AI震撼回檔！全球股票ETF受益人不減反增「這檔」定期定額單月暴增1600人
items.title_en: AI Shock Pullback! Global Stock ETFs See Beneficiary Numbers Not Decrease but Increase, This ETF’s Regular Investment Subscribers Jumped 1,600 in One Month
paras: 近期全球科技股出現明顯回檔，AI行情邁入嚴格驗證期，全球股票型ETF因具備分散風險優勢，吸引大量投資人進場，帶動相關ETF受益人與定期定額人數雙雙增加。統計5檔全球股票型ETF截至9月底定期定額變化，貝萊德世界股票(009826-TW)定期定額人數大增超過1600人，最新人數達3823人，基金規模更衝破87億元大關，成為震盪市場中的熱門避風港。
市場專家分析，在近期5檔全球型ETF中，僅有009826持股數超過千檔，廣泛分散在近40個國家，並涵蓋大中小型股，相較於其他同類型ETF持股多落在50至100檔之間，009826讓投資人能以1檔ETF涵蓋全球近90%可投資市值。當科技股面臨回檔修正時，其高度分散的效果顯著，吸引定期定額人數與受益人在行情震盪時不減反增。
貝萊德世界股票(009826-TW)基金經理人楊貽甯表示，美國期中選舉後全球科技股震盪加劇，AI投資熱潮迎來市場嚴格檢視。然而，短線股價修正並不代表AI趨勢反轉，變革潛力仍持續看好。科技股賣壓並未全面擴散至所有產業，反映市場正進行明顯的產業輪動，投資布局須將過往高度集中於AI或少數科技巨頭的方式，擴大至不同產業。
楊貽甯指出，最新企業動態顯示AI資本支出與相關營收成長動能仍受關注，且生產力提升與應用機會正逐步由半導體、雲端運算等基礎建設，向電商、支付、醫療、工業等產業擴散。檢視009826投資範圍，涵蓋全球已開發及新興市場，截至2026年10月30日，除了資訊科技占比30.16%外，亦布局金融16.70%、工業10.62%、醫療保健9.39%及非必需消費8.51%，透過全球多元布局參與不同產業成長。
楊貽甯認為，在市場領先族群快速輪動之際，與其猜測下一個贏家，不如透過全球市場一次布局，降低單一市場與產業集中度，作為長期參與全球經濟與科技創新的核心配置。定期定額則是克服人性、降低擇時壓力的投資方式，透過紀律投入分散不同時點波動，避免追高殺低，讓投資人更有機會留在市場參與長期成長。

paras_en: Recently, global technology stocks have shown a noticeable pullback, putting the AI rally into a strict validation phase. Global equity ETFs, thanks to their risk‑diversification advantage, have attracted a large influx of investors, driving up both the number of ETF beneficiaries and regular‑investment participants. Statistics on five global equity ETFs up to the end of September show that BlackRock World Stock (009826‑TW) saw its regular‑investment subscriber count surge by more than 1,600, reaching 3,823, while its fund size broke the NT$8.7 billion mark, making it a popular safe haven in a volatile market.

Among the five global ETFs examined, only 009826 holds more than a thousand securities, spread across nearly 40 countries and covering large, mid‑ and small‑cap stocks. In contrast, peer ETFs typically hold between 50 and 100 securities. 009826 allows investors to capture roughly 90% of the investable global market with a single fund. When tech stocks undergo a correction, its high diversification proves especially effective, attracting more regular‑investment participants and beneficiaries even as the market wavers.

BlackRock World Stock fund manager Yang Yi‑ning said that after the U.S. mid‑term elections, global tech stocks have become more volatile and the AI investment frenzy is now under stricter market scrutiny. However, short‑term price corrections do not signal a reversal of the AI trend; the sector’s transformative potential remains strong. The selling pressure in tech has not spread to all industries, indicating a clear sector rotation, and investors should broaden their allocations beyond the previously AI‑centric or few‑tech‑giant focus.

Yang noted that the latest corporate data show AI capital expenditures and related revenue growth remain in focus, with productivity gains and application opportunities gradually expanding from semiconductor and cloud‑computing infrastructure to e‑commerce, payments, healthcare, and industrial sectors. Reviewing 009826’s holdings, it covers both developed and emerging markets; as of October 30, 2026, information technology accounts for 30.16% of the portfolio, while financials make up 16.70%, industrials 10.62%, healthcare 9.39% and consumer discretionary 8.51%, allowing participation in diverse industry growth worldwide.

Yang believes that when leading market groups rotate quickly, rather than guessing the next winner, investors should allocate once across the global market to reduce concentration in any single market or industry, forming a core long‑term position in the global economy and tech innovation. Regular‑investment plans help overcome behavioral biases and timing pressure, enabling disciplined, diversified contributions over different market moments, avoiding buying high and selling low, and giving investors a better chance to stay in the market for long‑term growth.

items.title: 法人：台股短線沉澱不改AI長期動能 宜採「多策略配置」迎戰高波動
items.title_en: Institutional View: Taiwan Market’s Short‑Term Pause Doesn’t Alter AI’s Long‑Term Momentum – Adopt “Multi‑Strategy Allocation” to Face High Volatility
paras: 受美股大跌及美國期中選舉後政策不確定性影響，台股6日陷入劇烈震盪，雖盤中在護盤資金挹注下急衝逾2,000點，終場仍重挫1,873.08點，失守4萬點大關。安聯投信指出，此波修正主因評價調整與資金沉澱，AI長線趨勢與台股企業獲利動能並未改變。面對高波動與產業分化加劇的市場環境，建議布局優先聚焦科技龍頭、半導體及AI供應鏈，並搭配金融等多元配置，以穩健掌握中長期結構性成長機會。
因應市場震盪，國安基金已決議進場護盤，國安基金自民國89年成立以來，總額維持5000億元，此次也是史上第十次進場，前一次為 2025 年4月9日川普祭出對等關稅。此外，金管會9日起亦將祭出限空令，包括調降每日盤中借券賣出委託數量上限，調高融券保證金成數，期望透過多項穩定措施，抑制極端空頭炒作，並同步擴大投資人補繳擔保品的管道，全力維護資本市場穩定。
安聯台灣大壩及台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中分析，美國期中選舉後市場擔憂民主黨強化AI與資料中心監管，導致Nasdaq及費半指數劇烈修正，引發亞股恐慌性賣壓。然而，目前資料中心建設主要挑戰為成本上升而非投資放緩，加上供應鏈緊俏，對相關業者實質影響有限。
蕭惠中強調，本波修正反映政策不確定性、評價調整與籌碼沉澱，AI供應鏈短線承受評價壓力，但基本面與中長期獲利動能未變。台股2027年企業獲利成長動能依然強勁，短線待籌碼沉澱後，仍看好半導體、IP/ASIC、先進封裝、AI伺服器零組件及光通訊等產業龍頭與高業績能見度族群。
針對後市布局，安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆指出，高評價下個股與產業表現將更趨分化。目前團隊以金融控股為最大配置以提高多元性、掌握輪動，成長股則涵蓋晶圓代工、先進封裝及散熱等科技鏈。
安聯台灣主動式ETF(00993A-TW)經理人郭勁甫補充，聯準會利率政策、美債殖利率及地緣政治仍為關鍵變數。在高利率、高評價與高波動環境下，企業獲利能見度將成為驗證關鍵，市場將由齊漲轉向個股分化，採多策略配置有助於穩健掌握結構性機會。

paras_en: Affected by the sharp drop in U.S. equities and policy uncertainty after the U.S. mid‑term elections, Taiwan’s stock market swung wildly on the 6th. Although it surged more than 2,000 points mid‑session thanks to protective capital inflows, it closed down 1,873.08 points, slipping below the 40,000‑point mark. Allianz Global Investors said the correction was mainly due to valuation adjustments and capital sedimentation, while the long‑term AI trend and earnings momentum of Taiwanese firms remain unchanged. In a high‑volatility, increasingly sector‑divergent environment, they recommend focusing on technology leaders, semiconductors and the AI supply chain, complemented by diversified allocations such as financials, to steadily capture mid‑ to long‑term structural growth opportunities.

In response to the market turbulence, the National Security Fund has decided to intervene for market support. Since its establishment in 2000, the fund has maintained a total size of NT$500 billion; this is its tenth intervention, the previous one occurring on April 9 2025 when President Trump imposed reciprocal tariffs. Moreover, starting on the 9th the Financial Supervisory Commission will impose short‑selling limits, including lowering the daily intraday borrowing‑sell order cap and raising the margin requirement for securities lending, aiming to curb extreme short‑selling activity, expand channels for investors to post additional collateral, and fully safeguard market stability.

Allianz Taiwan’s “Dam” and Technology Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung analyzed that after the U.S. mid‑term elections, market concerns that the Democratic Party might tighten AI and data‑center regulation led to a sharp correction in the Nasdaq and the PHI Semiconductor Index, sparking panic selling in Asian equities. However, the main challenge for data‑center construction now is rising costs rather than a slowdown in investment, and with a tight supply chain the actual impact on related companies is limited.

Hsu emphasized that the current correction reflects policy uncertainty, valuation adjustments and capital sedimentation. The AI supply chain faces short‑term valuation pressure, but fundamentals and mid‑ to long‑term earnings momentum remain intact. Taiwan’s corporate earnings growth outlook for 2027 stays strong; after capital settles, the outlook remains positive for semiconductor, IP/ASIC, advanced packaging, AI server components and optical communications leaders as well as high‑visibility earnings groups.

Regarding future positioning, Liou Pen‑Long, manager of Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW), noted that under high valuations individual stocks and sectors will diverge further. The team’s biggest allocation is to financial holding companies to boost diversification and capture rotation, while growth holdings cover wafer foundries, advanced packaging and cooling technologies within the tech chain.

Guo Jing‑Fu, manager of Allianz Taiwan Active ETF (00993A‑TW), added that Federal Reserve rate policy, U.S. Treasury yields and geopolitical factors remain key variables. In an environment of high rates, high valuations and high volatility, earnings visibility will be the decisive test, and the market will shift from broad rally to stock‑specific differentiation; a multi‑strategy allocation helps steadily capture structural opportunities.

items.title: 力晶投控爭取股東支持出招 庫藏股每股42元、股東會送1088元商品券
items.title_en: Licheng Investment Holdings Seeks Shareholder Support with Treasury Stock at NT$42 per Share and NT$1,088 Burger King Vouchers at AGM
paras: 力晶投控積極推動登錄興櫃，為爭取股東支持，11月25日臨時股東會祭出面額1,088元的漢堡王商品券作為股東會禮品，同時透過庫藏股及引進產業上下游友好廠商投資等方式，增加未上市股票流動性。力晶投控表示，總額10億元的庫藏股計畫已完成初步審查，符合資格的股東可依每股42元出售股票，預計11月20日支付股款；此外，近期也陸續接獲多家廠商表達投資意願，可望接續推出公開購買股權計畫。
力晶投控指出，日前推出的10億元庫藏股計畫，已完成初步審查，凡於截止申請前完成遞件且資料無誤的股東，均可依每股42元價格出售登記股數。審查合格通知函預計於9日寄出，股東後續可依通知辦理完稅及股票過戶，公司則將於11月20日匯出股款。
除庫藏股外，力晶投控也積極引進外部投資。針對山一投資日前宣布推出總額10億元的股權公開投資案，力晶投控表示，歡迎山一投資透過合法公開方式取得公司股權。
公司近期也陸續接獲產業上下游友好廠商的投資詢問，主要是看好力晶投控的基本面及未來發展，預期近期將有多家業者陸續推出公開購買股權計畫，提供未上市股票持有人更多交易及資金變現管道。
另一方面，力晶投控將於11月25日召開臨時股東會，討論修改公司章程及改選董監事等重大議案，相關決議攸關後續登錄興櫃規劃。為爭取股東參與及支持，公司此次也準備面額1,088元的漢堡王商品券作為股東會禮品，股東可持股東會通知書，至全通、長龍等委託書通路兌換。
力晶投控表示，登錄興櫃是公司未來發展的重要階段，也攸關全體股東權益，因此希望透過此次股東會凝聚共識，推動相關議案順利通過，朝興櫃及上市櫃目標邁進。
paras_en: Licheng Investment Holdings is actively pushing for listing on the Emerging Stock Board. To win shareholder support, the company’s extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on November 25 will offer Burger King vouchers worth NT$1,088 as a meeting gift. At the same time, it will increase liquidity of its unlisted shares through a treasury‑stock program and by attracting friendly upstream and downstream industry investors. Licheng says the NT$10 billion treasury‑stock plan has passed an initial review; eligible shareholders may sell shares at NT$42 each, with payment expected on November 20. In addition, several firms have recently expressed investment interest, paving the way for a public equity‑purchase program.

Licheng notes that the NT$10 billion treasury‑stock plan has completed its preliminary review. Shareholders who submit correct applications before the deadline may sell their registered shares at NT$42 per share. Notification letters confirming eligibility are slated to be mailed on the 9th, after which shareholders can settle taxes and transfer shares; the company will remit the proceeds on November 20.

Beyond the treasury‑stock initiative, Licheng is actively courting external investors. Regarding Shanyi Investment’s recent announcement of a NT$10 billion public equity‑investment project, Licheng welcomes Shanyi to acquire company shares through a lawful public offering.

The company has also been approached by several friendly firms along its industry’s supply chain, who are optimistic about Licheng’s fundamentals and future growth. It expects multiple parties to soon launch public equity‑purchase plans, giving holders of its unlisted stock more avenues for trading and cashing out.

On the other hand, Licheng will hold an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on November 25 to discuss major proposals such as amending the articles of incorporation and re‑electing directors and supervisors, matters critical to its upcoming Emerging Stock Board listing plan. To encourage participation and support, the company will provide Burger King vouchers worth NT$1,088 as a meeting gift; shareholders can present their meeting notices at authorized agents such as Quan‑Tong and Chang‑Long to redeem the vouchers.

Licheng states that listing on the Emerging Stock Board is a key stage in its development and vital to all shareholders’ interests. It hopes the meeting will build consensus and see the related proposals pass smoothly, moving the company toward its Emerging Board and eventual listed‑company goals.

items.title: 美股將反彈？高盛恐慌指標突破「極端門檻」、歷史數據揭標普500未來半年平均漲9%
items.title_en: Will US Stocks Rebound? Goldman Sachs Panic Index Breaks ‘Extreme Threshold’, Historical Data Shows S&P 500 Could Average 9% Gain Over Next Six Months
paras: 美股近期劇烈震盪，高盛恐慌指標升至歷史極端水準，歷史數據顯示，這可能預示美股中期反彈機會，但交易員提醒，市場目前仍處於尋底階段。
高盛交易員指出，該行追蹤的波動率恐慌指數周四（5日）攀升至9.57，逼近滿分10分，並突破代表極端恐慌的9.5門檻，單日升幅更創有紀錄以來第三大。加上周三（4日）市場大幅下挫，兩個交易日累計波動幅度刷新歷史紀錄。
不過，歷史數據顯示，恐慌指數過去15次突破9.5後，標普500指數在接下來3個月平均上漲4.6%，上漲機率達80%；以6個月為期，平均漲幅則達9%，期間指數上漲的比率為73%。
美股周五（6日）已出現反彈，標普500指數上漲0.7%，在經濟數據表現良好的背景下，部分投資人趁市場回檔進場布局。
不過，高盛交易員提醒，市場目前仍處於尋找底部的過程，短期波動恐尚未結束。

美股兩日波動創歷史紀錄　市場情緒急轉恐慌

高盛交易員Lee Coppersmith表示，這次美股連續兩個交易日的累計波動幅度創下歷史新高，反映市場情緒從原先的如釋重負迅速轉向全面恐慌。
高盛交易員分析，這波劇烈反轉與美國期中選舉前的避險需求有關。投資人在11月3日選舉前大舉買進下跌保護，隨後又在選後反彈行情中賣出避險部位，導致投資組合在股市反轉下跌時缺乏足夠保護。
隨著股價走低，避險基金陸續被迫平倉，進一步加劇市場賣壓，投資人也急於重新買回先前出售的保護性部位，使市場波動進一步擴大。

看跌期權成交量創新高　避險需求集中爆發

市場避險需求急遽升溫，也反映在期權交易活動上。芝加哥期權交易所（Cboe）周四（5日）的看跌期權成交量突破1,100萬張，創下單日歷史新高，超越2025年4月的前次紀錄。
其中，指數看跌期權占成交量主要部分，個股看跌期權成交量也創下歷史第四高，顯示投資人集中尋求市場避險工具，以降低股價進一步下跌帶來的風險。
Coppersmith指出，11月5日的市場走勢，與其說是企業基本面惡化所致，不如說更多反映市場技術面失衡，以及投資人被迫重新建立避險部位所帶來的壓力。

歷史數據指向中期反彈　高盛仍提醒市場尚未築底

儘管歷史數據呈現出較為樂觀的中期訊號，但高盛交易員也提醒，市場仍在尋底，投資人尚須消化更多持倉調整與去槓桿壓力。
Coppersmith表示，隨著被迫賣盤逐漸消退，市場資產配置的吸引力正在提升。這不代表投資人必須立即重返風險資產，但市場另一端潛在的投資機會已愈來愈值得關注。
整體而言，高盛認為，極端波動與被迫拋售可能逐步為中期投資創造進場機會，但仍須等待市場完成當前的去槓桿過程。
paras_en: US equities have been wildly volatile lately, with Goldman Sachs’ panic index soaring to historically extreme levels. Historical data suggest this could signal a medium‑term rebound opportunity, but traders warn the market is still in a bottom‑searching phase.

Goldman Sachs traders noted that the volatility‑panic index they track jumped to 9.57 on Thursday (the 5th), edging close to the maximum score of 10 and breaking the 9.5 level that marks extreme panic. The single‑day rise was the third‑largest on record. Coupled with a sharp market drop on Wednesday (the 4th), the two‑day cumulative volatility set a new historical high.

However, historical data show that after the panic index has breached 9.5 fifteen times, the S&P 500 has risen an average of 4.6% over the following three months, with an 80% probability of a gain; over a six‑month horizon the average rise is 9%, and the index has risen in 73% of those periods.
US stocks rebounded on Friday (the 6th), with the S&P 500 up 0.7% amid solid economic data, prompting some investors to enter on the dip and position themselves for a rally.
Nevertheless, Goldman Sachs traders caution that the market is still in the process of searching for a bottom, and short‑term volatility may not be over yet.
US equity volatility over two days set a historic record, reflecting a rapid shift in market sentiment from relief to full‑blown panic, said Goldman trader Lee Coppersmith.

Coppersmith explained that the sharp reversal is tied to hedging demand ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. Investors bought protection heavily before the November 3 election, then sold those hedges during the post‑election rally, leaving portfolios under‑protected when stocks turned lower.
As prices fell, hedge funds were forced to unwind positions, adding sell pressure, while investors rushed to buy back the protective positions they had sold, further amplifying market swings.

Put‑option volume hit a new high, reflecting a surge in hedging demand. Cboe reported that on Thursday (the 5th) put‑option contracts exceeded 11 million, a single‑day record surpassing the previous high set in April 2025.
Index puts made up the bulk of the volume, and single‑stock put volume reached the fourth‑highest level on record, showing investors were flocking to downside protection to curb further price drops.
Coppersmith said the market move on November 5 was less about deteriorating corporate fundamentals and more about technical imbalances and the pressure from investors forced to rebuild hedges.

Although the historical data point to a relatively optimistic medium‑term signal, Goldman traders stress the market is still bottom‑searching and investors need to digest further position adjustments and deleveraging pressure.

Coppersmith added that as forced selling eases, the appeal of asset allocation improves. This does not mean investors must rush back into risk assets, but the other side of the market is offering increasingly attractive opportunities.

Overall, Goldman believes that extreme volatility and forced selling could gradually create entry points for medium‑term investors, but the market must first complete its current deleveraging process.

items.title: 美股AI股拋售只是暫時的？分析師：市場過度解讀民主黨勝選、資料中心建設未必踩煞車
items.title_en: Is the US AI Stock Sell‑off Only Temporary? Analysts Say the Market Over‑interpreted the Democratic Victory and Data‑Center Construction May Not Be Stalled
paras: 美股晶片股在經歷六年來最嚴重的一波賣壓後，上周五（6日）迎來強勁反彈。不過，分析師提醒，這波反彈主要反映投資人趁股價下跌進場，並不代表市場對AI資料中心投資前景的疑慮已經消失，未來晶片股仍可能持續劇烈震盪。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，上周五收盤，超微半導體(AMD-US) 股價上漲11%，英特爾(INTC-US) 漲8%，美光科技(MU-US) 上漲5%；輝達(NVDA-US) 及Sandisk (SNDK-US) 分別上漲3%及4%，博通(AVGO-US) 則小漲不到1%。
StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee指出，上周四（5日）晶片股遭遇劇烈拋售，反而為周五布局AI相關晶片股創造明顯的短線反彈機會。
他表示，安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 周四重挫12%，相較之下，追蹤科技軟體股的iShares擴展科技軟體類股ETF(IGV-US) 雖同樣承壓，跌幅卻僅約4%。
Stifel分析師Brian Chin則將上周五的市場走勢形容為「波動率急遽反轉」。他認為，晶片股雖然反彈，但市場對未來資料中心支出的不確定性不會迅速消退，短期內仍可能持續引發股價波動。
不過，Chin也指出，美國期中選舉並未改變市場對AI的根本需求，真正變得更加複雜的是相關產業的監管環境。
周四美股收盤後，資料中心監管議題出現一些正面進展。其中，德州州長當選人Gina Hinojosa的最新表態，較市場原先預期溫和。
她競選期間曾承諾採取更嚴格的資料中心監管措施，但上周四接受《CNN》訪問時表示，自己並不排斥資料中心，只是希望在建立保障德州居民的措施之前，暫停目前的相關建設。
J. Gold Associates分析師Jack Gold認為，市場對民主黨在選舉中大獲全勝的反應過度，部分投資人甚至將選舉結果解讀為資料中心建設即將終結，進而預期晶片股將受到重大衝擊。他認為，俄亥俄州及紐約州的政治人物也可能調整立場。
Gold表示，這波拋售跌幅過大，並補充稱，目前已有投資者趁低價入場。
創投公司Deep33管理合夥人Lior Prosor則指出，即使美國資料中心建設暫時放緩，也不代表AI相關企業未來幾季營收必然下滑。
他認為，原本可用的運算容量可能轉而滿足其他地區的需求，因為算力需求遍及全球，大型雲端業者也正在世界各地興建資料中心。
Prosor並表示，市場可能即將迎來一段時間以來，企業對財報展望與市場預期最為謹慎的財報季，這反而可能為企業實際業績優於預期創造更大空間。
Pilot Wave Holdings合夥人Mark Spindel也指出，上周四市場將AI資本支出、資料中心政策風險、通膨及利率上升等不同疑慮集中反映在同一波交易中；周五的反彈則顯示，投資人開始重新區分這些風險，而非將其視為單一問題。
Spindel強調，晶片需求並未消失，但隨著投資者重新評估AI基礎設施建設的時間表，市場出現「短期波動」在所難免。
此外，《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic截至10月底的年經常性營收（ARR）已超過800億美元，高於9月底的水準，為AI產業需求帶來另一項正面訊號。
不過，報導也指出，部分Anthropic投資人認為，公司原先設定的1.5兆美元IPO估值目標可能需要下修。
儘管晶片股已出現反彈，投資人仍須為後續波動做好準備。Lee提醒，在市場劇烈震盪期間，投資人不宜做出非理性的投資組合調整。
paras_en: US chip stocks, after enduring the most severe sell‑off in six years, staged a strong rebound last Friday (the 6th). However, analysts warn that this bounce mainly reflects investors buying the dip and does not mean concerns over AI data‑center investment prospects have vanished; chip stocks may continue to experience sharp volatility.
According to MarketWatch, at Friday’s close AMD rose 11%, Intel 8%, Micron 5%; Nvidia and Sandisk gained 3% and 4% respectively, while Broadcom edged up less than 1%.
StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee noted that the heavy sell‑off on Thursday (the 5th) created a clear short‑term rebound opportunity for AI‑related chip stocks on Friday.
He said the SOXX semiconductor ETF plunged 12% on Thursday, whereas the iShares Expanded Tech‑Software ETF (IGV), which tracks software stocks, also fell but only about 4%.

Stifel analyst Brian Chin described Friday’s market move as a “sharp volatility reversal.” He believes that although chip stocks rebounded, uncertainty about future data‑center spending will not dissipate quickly and could keep driving price swings in the short term.
Nonetheless, Chin added that the US midterm elections have not altered the fundamental demand for AI; what has become more complex is the regulatory environment for related industries.
After Thursday’s market close, there were some positive developments on data‑center regulation. Texas governor‑elect Gina Hinojosa’s latest remarks were milder than the market had expected.

During her campaign she pledged stricter data‑center regulations, but in a CNN interview on Thursday she said she is not opposed to data centers, only that she wants to pause current projects until safeguards for Texas residents are in place.

J. Gold Associates analyst Jack Gold believes the market over‑reacted to the Democrats’ sweeping election win, with some investors interpreting the result as signaling an end to data‑center construction and expecting a major hit to chip stocks. He notes that politicians in Ohio and New York may also shift their stances.
Gold said the sell‑off was excessive and added that investors are already buying at lower prices.

Deep33 venture‑capital partner Lior Prosor pointed out that even if US data‑center construction temporarily slows, it does not mean AI‑related companies’ revenues will necessarily decline in the coming quarters.
He argues that the available compute capacity could be redirected to other regions, as demand for compute is global and major cloud providers are building data centers worldwide.
Prosor also said the market may be entering a earnings season where companies are most cautious about outlooks versus market expectations, which could actually give firms more room to beat forecasts.

Pilot Wave Holdings partner Mark Spindel noted that on Thursday the market bundled AI capex, data‑center policy risk, inflation and rising rates into a single wave of trading; Friday’s rebound shows investors are beginning to separate these risks rather than treating them as a single issue.
Spindel emphasized that chip demand has not vanished, but as investors reassess the timeline for AI infrastructure build‑out, short‑term volatility is inevitable.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Anthropic’s annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceeded $80 billion as of the end of October, up from the September level, providing another positive signal for AI demand.
The report also noted that some Anthropic investors think the company’s original $1.5 trillion IPO valuation target may need to be revised downward.

Even though chip stocks have rebounded, investors should remain prepared for further swings. Lee cautioned that during periods of sharp market turbulence, investors should avoid making irrational portfolio adjustments.

items.title: Anthropic砸34億美元搶電力！預訂1.7GW燃氣發電機、支應AI資料中心需求
items.title_en: Anthropic Spends $3.4 Billion on Power, Orders 1.7 GW of Gas Generators to Support AI Data Centers
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic持續擴大AI基礎設施布局。據悉，該公司已達成一筆價值約34億美元的交易，用於取得用於資料中心的燃氣發電設備。
根據《金融時報》周日（8日）報導，Anthropic於9月下旬向總部位於美國德州聖安東尼奧的設備供應商OnePWR Solutions達成協議，預訂了總容量達1.7 GW的大型發電機供應，是目前已知AI實驗室單筆規模最大的發電設備採購案。
報導引述知情人士指出，這筆交易並不涉及收購OnePWR本身，該公司也沒有員工轉至Anthropic任職，但Anthropic取得的交易內容包含安裝這批發電機所需的工程及施工能力。
報導另指出，Anthropic最初計畫向OnePWR購買電力，後來則改為接手該公司向美國設備製造商Caterpillar訂購的發電機。
不過，Anthropic與OnePWR目前尚未回應。
《彭博》指出，這筆交易是AI實驗室進一步深入能源產業的最新跡象。在爭相確保稀缺電力設備供應之際，AI業者也開始繞過中間商，直接取得所需資源。
此外，這筆交易也反映出，在長期高度依賴合作夥伴來獲取電力、晶片、資料中心和土地資源之後，Anthropic 正尋求對其 AI 營運背後的基礎設施實現更強的掌控。
《路透》9月曾報導，Anthropic預計未來10年投入超過5,000億美元建設AI基礎設施；《彭博》則報導稱，Anthropic上周曾表示，未來幾年計畫投入超過8,950億美元，其中大部分將用於運算能力成本及基礎設施。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic continues to expand its AI infrastructure footprint. The company has reportedly struck a deal worth about $3.4 billion to acquire gas‑powered generation equipment for its data centers.

According to the Financial Times on Sunday the 8th, Anthropic reached an agreement in late September with OnePWR Solutions, a Texas‑based equipment supplier, to reserve large generators with a total capacity of 1.7 GW – the largest single‑unit power‑equipment purchase known for an AI lab.

The report, citing sources, says the transaction does not involve acquiring OnePWR itself and no OnePWR staff are moving to Anthropic, but the deal includes the engineering and construction services needed to install the generators.
The article also notes that Anthropic originally planned to buy electricity from OnePWR, but later decided to take over the generators that OnePWR had ordered from U.S. equipment maker Caterpillar.
Anthropic and OnePWR have not yet responded to inquiries.

Bloomberg said the deal is the latest sign that AI labs are moving deeper into the energy sector. As firms scramble for scarce power‑equipment, AI players are bypassing intermediaries and securing the resources directly.

The transaction also reflects Anthropic’s shift toward greater control over the infrastructure behind its AI operations after years of relying heavily on partners for power, chips, data‑center space and land.

Reuters reported in September that Anthropic expects to invest more than $500 billion over the next decade in AI infrastructure; Bloomberg said the company last week announced plans to spend over $895 billion in the coming years, most of it on compute costs and infrastructure.

items.title: 史上最大GPU竊盜案！加州奧克蘭發生特大貨運搶劫案　價值1140萬美元輝達硬體失蹤
items.title_en: Largest GPU Theft in History! Massive Cargo Heist in Oakland, California—$11.4 Million Worth of NVIDIA Hardware Vanishes
paras: 美國加州奧克蘭近期發生一起精心策劃的貨運竊盜案，一批價值1140萬美元的輝達貨物在運輸途中離奇失踪，被多家媒體稱為「史上最大GPU竊盜案」。
調查顯示，一輛裝載輝達貨物的卡車於今年8月29日從加州奧克蘭出發，原定運往德州沃思堡，取貨流程符合原定安排，但卡車最終失聯，受害者9月13日向警方報案。該批貨物共六個托盤。
美國加州奧克蘭市警方正進行調查，被竊物品為AI晶片和電腦硬件，價值高達1140萬美元。分析師表示，這可能是一起針對高科技企業精心策劃的竊盜案。
警方追蹤發現，卡車曾在途中多次停靠，單次停留時長達數小時，最終在加州東南部聖貝納迪諾縣失去蹤跡。截至目前，警方尚未逮捕任何嫌疑人。
據悉，這並非輝達首次遭遇貨物被盜事件，且是目前已知單筆案值最高的輝達單車貨運失竊事件。近年來美國高價值科技貨品劫案頻傳，先前加州就有多起針對輝達貨物的竊盜案件。
柏克萊加州大學分校教授Olaf J. Groth分析，輝達AI晶片市場需求旺盛，海外售價約為美國本土兩倍，巨大的利潤空間催生犯罪動機。本次案件佈局周密，也反映出竊案集團持續走向職業化。
paras_en: A meticulously planned cargo theft recently occurred in Oakland, California, where a shipment worth $11.4 million in NVIDIA goods mysteriously disappeared en route, being dubbed by multiple media outlets as the "largest GPU theft in history."

Investigators say a truck carrying the NVIDIA cargo left Oakland on August 29 and was slated for Fort Worth, Texas. The pickup process followed the scheduled plan, but the truck later went missing, prompting the victim to file a police report on September 13. The shipment consisted of six pallets.

Oakland police are investigating the case; the stolen items include AI chips and computer hardware valued at up to $11.4 million. Analysts suggest the theft appears to be a carefully orchestrated operation targeting a high‑tech company.

Police tracking shows the truck made several stops along the way, some lasting several hours, and ultimately vanished in San Bernardino County in southeastern California. No suspects have been arrested so far.

This is not the first time NVIDIA has suffered a cargo theft, and it is currently the single highest‑value incident known for a stolen NVIDIA shipment. In recent years, high‑value tech cargo robberies have become frequent in the U.S., with several prior thefts of NVIDIA goods reported in California.

Professor Olaf J. Groth of the University of California, Berkeley, notes that demand for NVIDIA AI chips is strong, with overseas prices roughly twice those in the United States, creating huge profit margins that fuel criminal motives. The sophisticated planning of this case also reflects the growing professionalization of theft groups.

items.title: 白銀長線看多？分析師喊明年75美元 短線仍有兩大考驗
items.title_en: Is Silver Bullish Over the Long Term? Analysts Forecast $75 Next Year, Yet Two Short‑Term Tests Remain
paras: 黃金與白銀上週雙雙反彈，白銀漲勢略勝一籌，金銀比收在 78.45 倍。展望後市，部分分析師看好白銀未來一年跑贏黃金，預期金銀比可能降至約 67 倍；但也有分析師提醒，白銀尚未建立持續上升趨勢，利率環境與資金流向仍是反彈能否延續的關鍵。
上週五 (6 日)，COMEX 12 月黃金期貨結算價下跌 0.94%，收在每盎司 4,074.90 美元；12 月白銀期貨下跌 0.83%，收在每盎司 51.942 美元。依兩者結算價計算，金銀比由前一交易日的 78.54 倍，小幅降至 78.45 倍，代表一盎司黃金的價格約相當於 78.45 盎司白銀。
白銀單週漲5.41%，相對表現略勝黃金
儘管週五回落，黃金與白銀期貨上週仍分別上漲約 4.51% 與 5.41%，白銀漲幅領先約 0.9 個百分點，顯示本輪反彈已出現追趕走勢。
Augmont 研究主管 Renisha Chainani 週五接受訪問時預估，到 2027 年 11 月前後，白銀可能升至每盎司約 75 美元，金銀比則可能降至約 67 倍，反映她看好白銀未來一年相對黃金的表現。
不過，Bonanza Portfolio 資深研究分析師 Nirpendra Yadav 認為，白銀仍未建立持續上升趨勢，未來 6 至 12 個月若要復甦，需要黃金恢復漲勢，以及投資資金重新流入貴金屬。
Yadav 指出，銀價必須突破並站穩每盎司 62 美元，才可能挑戰 70 美元的重要阻力；若明確跌破 47 美元，則可能持續承壓。
VSRK Capital 董事 Swapnil Aggarwal 也對年底前走勢保持謹慎，認為白銀長期雖有復甦可能，短期卻不預期出現明顯回升，仍須觀察利率展望。
強勁非農考驗金價，利率仍牽動貴金屬
短期壓力主要來自美國貨幣政策。上週五強於預期的美國就業數據推升美元與美債殖利率，並強化市場對聯準會 12 月升息的預期，對不孳息的貴金屬構成壓力。
獨立金屬交易員 Tai Wong 表示，全面強勁的就業報告使黃金跳空下跌，儘管價格試圖收復失土，這仍是對當週漲勢的一次考驗。
從上述因素分析，若美元與實質利率持續偏高，黃金與白銀都可能受到壓抑；白銀又兼具工業原料特性，若製造業需求轉弱，其相對表現未必能持續優於黃金。
世界白銀協會委託 Metals Focus 編製的《2026 年世界白銀調查》指出，2025 年全球白銀工業需求減少 3%，降至 6.574 億盎司。AI 基礎建設、汽車與電網投資雖提供支撐，但太陽能業者加速降低單位產品用銀量與採用替代材料，抵銷部分成長。
該報告於今年 4 月預估，2026 年工業需求將再減少約 3%，但全球白銀市場仍將連續第六年供不應求，年度缺口估達 4,630 萬盎司。這意味白銀同時面臨供應缺口與需求降溫，價格方向取決於兩股力量如何消長。
paras_en: Gold and silver both rebounded last week, with silver edging ahead; the gold‑to‑silver ratio closed at 78.45 times. Looking ahead, some analysts are optimistic that silver will outperform gold over the next year, expecting the ratio to fall to around 67 times, while others caution that silver has not yet established a sustained uptrend and that interest‑rate conditions and capital flows will be key to whether the rebound can continue.

On Friday (the 6th), the COMEX December gold futures settlement fell 0.94% to $4,074.90 per ounce, while December silver futures slipped 0.83% to $51.942 per ounce. Based on these settlement prices, the gold‑to‑silver ratio eased slightly from 78.54 times the previous day to 78.45 times, meaning one ounce of gold is priced at roughly 78.45 ounces of silver.
Silver rose 5.41% for the week, marginally out‑performing gold.
